title.en: Electric 30 or low-pressure 40 for fine-stone buildings?
title.zh: 细石建筑选电动30还是低压40？

description.en: Both print 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa. Electric 30 fine stone is 60 m / 180 m and also has aggregate 13. Low-pressure 40 fine stone is 80 m / 240 m and has no aggregate-13 row.
description.zh: 两台都是 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa。电动30细石是 60 m / 180 m，并另有 13 骨料行。低压40细石是 80 m / 240 m，没有 13 骨料行。

h1.en: Electric 30 or low-pressure 40 for fine-stone buildings?
h1.zh: 细石建筑选电动30还是低压40？

directAnswer.en: If the mix is fine stone and the pipe fits 60 m horizontal / 180 m vertical, Electric 30 is the printed row at 30 kW. If the fine-stone pipe needs the longer 80 m / 240 m window, open Electric Low Pressure 40 at 37 kW. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints both as building pumps at 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa. Only Electric 30 also prints aggregate 13 at 20 m / 60 m.
directAnswer.zh: 料是细石且管路落在水平 60 m / 垂直 180 m 内，电动30就是 30 kW 的那一行。细石管路需要更长的 80 m / 240 m 窗口，就打开 37 kW 的电动低压40。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都写成 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa 的建筑泵。只有电动30另外印了 13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。

heading.en: Same output does not mean the same distance
heading.zh: 输送量相同不等于距离相同

body.en: Both list 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, size 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. The motors differ (30 kW and 37 kW). The fine-stone distances differ. Low-pressure 40 also prints a Kawasaki 112 hydraulic pump cell that Electric 30’s table does not list in the same way. Match the distance row you need, then the motor the site can feed.
body.zh: 两台都列了 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm 和 1200 kg。电机不同（30 kW 和 37 kW）。细石距离不同。低压40还印了川崎 112 液压泵格，电动30的表没有按同样方式列出。先对你需要的距离行，再对现场能供的电机。

heading.en: Aggregate 13 has only one of these pages

body.en: Electric 30 maximum aggregate is ≤ 3 cm, with the short aggregate-13 distance. Electric Low Pressure 40 does not print that second distance and does not print a maximum-aggregate cell in the specification list. A 13-aggregate building line should not be assigned to the low-pressure 40 from silence.
body.zh: 电动30最大骨料是 ≤ 3 cm，并有较短的 13 骨料距离。电动低压40没有印第二段距离，规格表里也没有最大骨料格。不能因为空白就把 13 骨料建筑管路分给低压40。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Write “fine stone” only if that is the mix name you can stand behind. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 只有你能确认料名是细石时，才写“细石”。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: Yes. Both print 1200 kg. The distances do not match just because the weight does.
answer.zh: 一样。两台都印 1200 kg。重量相同并不表示距离相同。

question.en: Is the standard Electric 40 in this pair?
question.zh: 标准电动40在这一对里吗？

answer.en: No. Standard Electric 40 is 45 kW and 21 m³/h. It is the medium-building row.
answer.zh: 不在。标准电动40是 45 kW、21 m³/h，属于中型建筑行。

answer.en: /solutions/construction, because both products print building and commercial placement.
answer.zh: /solutions/construction，因为两台产品都印了建筑与商业浇筑。
